title: Hold a licence to use animals for research or teaching
what: Use or breed animals for research or teaching only under a licence.

sources.title: Animal Welfare Act 1992 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 25(1) (current republication (R36, from 6 December 2025; Animal Welfare Act 1992 | Acts))
